welcome.tagline: Design jewelry by chatting. Projects are saved as .fc files.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyHint: Describe a piece, its stones and measurements. Attach reference photos if you have them.
chat.s1: A signet ring with an engraved initial
chat.s2: Pendant with a pear-cut stone in a bezel
chat.s3: Stud earrings with 4 mm round stones
chat.placeholder: Describe your piece or a change…
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.mockReply: Done — I updated the model and re-rendered it. Have a look at the preview and tell me what to adjust.

preview.title: Preview
preview.gizmo: Click an axis to snap the camera
preview.empty: The model has no geometry yet.
preview.noFit: Does not fit the plate: {{size}} mm
preview.moveSprue: Move the sprue: click the piece to place it there
preview.editSupports: Edit supports: click the piece to add one, click a support to remove it
preview.layoutFailed: Could not build the print layout: {{error}}

settings.title: Project settings
settings.autosave: Changes apply to this project; save to keep them.
settings.name: Name
settings.metalHint: Used for weight estimates and the preview tint.
settings.previewQualityHint: Facets used in fast previews; exports always use full quality.
settings.tiltHint: Fine detail should face upwards after tilting.
settings.optimizeIntro: Reduce the triangle count of exported meshes. Rejected automatically if the volume changes too much.
settings.keepHint: Percentage of the original triangles to keep.
settings.maxVolumeHint: Safety check: the export is refused above this.
settings.raftThicknessHint: 0 = no raft. Must be thinner than the lift.
settings.liftHint: Gap between the piece and the plate.
settings.autoDone: {{added}} supports added; {{blocked}} spots skipped because a pillar would cross the piece.
settings.checksIntro: Checks the piece for problems that can ruin a print.

rejected.volume: rejected: volume would change too much

settings.sprueManual: Manual position. You can also move the sprue in the preview.
settings.sprueAuto: Automatic position. Edit it, or move the sprue in the preview.

export.title: Export
export.noSupports: (enable and generate supports in Project settings)
export.safety: Export is refused if volume changes by more than {{max}}%.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.hint: Applies to the whole app, not just this project.

findings.watertight: Watertight: every edge is shared by exactly two triangles.
findings.inverted: Normals are inverted: the model is inside-out.
findings.degenerate: {{detail}} degenerate triangles removed from the check.
findings.shells: {{detail}} separate shells: loose parts each need support.
findings.tooBig: Does not fit the printer volume in any orientation.
findings.noThin: No walls thinner than {{limit}} mm found.
findings.thin: Thin walls: {{n}} region(s), thinnest {{min}} mm, ~{{area}} mm² below {{limit}} mm. Brittle or may not print.
findings.noGaps: No gaps narrower than {{limit}} mm found.
findings.gaps: Narrow gaps: {{n}} region(s), narrowest {{min}} mm, ~{{area}} mm² closer than {{limit}} mm. May fill with resin.
findings.selfInt: {{detail}} pair(s) of crossing triangles: the surface cuts through itself.
findings.fillNoFeed: Casting fill check skipped: no mass thicker than {{detail}} mm to feed from.
findings.fillOk: Casting fill: every thin section is close to a thick mass.
findings.fill: Casting fill: thin sections up to {{worst}} mm from any thick mass (limit {{reach}} mm). The metal may freeze before filling them.
findings.deepSkipped: Thickness, gap and intersection checks skipped: fix the problems above first.
